doc.field: Series V: Artworks, Sketches and Posters
Series V contains primarily visual material produced by Foreman, including sketches, drafts, and posters from her own as well as others' performances and exhibitions.

The materials in Series V are arranged alphabetically by folder title. The majority of the works are untitled. Where posssible, entire sketchbooks are housed intact. Otherwise, materials remain in their original arrangements.
